title: StoreAndForwardReport v1 — the store-and-forward mailbox at a moment: the policy it holds under, every task record in queue order, every expiry notice in the order tasks expired, how many tasks stand held now, and the counted lifetime totals — queued, delivered, expired, and cancelled, with refusals counted apart by name; simulated is a constant — the mailbox is an in-process holding and no LAN was crossed (Y-061)
